mapper.select: SELECT r.report_date AS "day", SUM(r.good_qty) AS "good", SUM(r.scrap_qty) AS "scrap" FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op o ON o.id = r.op_id WHERE r.report_date >= #{begin} AND r.report_date <= #{end} AND o.work_center_id = #{wc} GROUP BY r.report_date ORDER BY r.report_date

SELECT c.name AS "name", c.daily_hours * c.resources AS "capacity", COALESCE(t.hours, 0) AS "hours", COALESCE(t.good, 0) AS "good", COALESCE(t.scrap, 0) AS "scrap" FROM mes_work_center c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.work_center_id, SUM(r.hours) AS hours, SUM(r.good_qty) AS good, SUM(r.scrap_qty) AS scrap FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op o ON o.id = r.op_id WHERE r.report_date = #{day} GROUP BY o.work_center_id ) t ON t.work_center_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.id = #{wc} ORDER BY c.code

SELECT e.code AS "code", e.name AS "name", e.status AS "status", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, e.status) AS "statusLabel", c.name AS "workCenter", COALESCE(g.good, 0) AS "good", COALESCE(s.hours, 0) AS "stopHours" FROM mes_equipment e LEFT JOIN mes_work_center c ON c.id = e.work_center_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'mes_equipment_status' AND dd.dict_value = e.status LEFT JOIN ( SELECT equipment_id, SUM(good_qty) AS good FROM mes_report WHERE report_date = #{day} AND equipment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipment_id ) g ON g.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT equipment_id, SUM(hours) AS hours FROM mes_equipment_stop WHERE start_time >= #{monthBegin} GROUP BY equipment_id ) s ON s.equipment_id = e.id WHERE e.status <> 'SCRAPPED' AND e.work_center_id = #{wc} ORDER BY e.code

SELECT COALESCE(dd.dict_label, s.reason) AS "label", SUM(s.hours) AS "hours", s.reason AS "value" FROM mes_equipment_stop s JOIN mes_equipment e ON e.id = s.equipment_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'mes_stop_reason' AND dd.dict_value = s.reason WHERE s.start_time >= #{begin} AND s.start_time < #{end} AND e.work_center_id = #{wc} GROUP BY s.reason, dd.dict_label ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT w.wo_no AS "woNo", m.name AS "product", w.qty AS "qty", w.finished_qty AS "finishedQty", w.plan_end AS "planEnd", w.status AS "status", (SELECT o.good_qty FROM mes_wo_op o WHERE o.wo_id = w.id ORDER BY o.seq DESC LIMIT 1) AS "doneQty", (SELECT o.name FROM mes_wo_op o WHERE o.wo_id = w.id AND o.good_qty + o.scrap_qty < w.qty ORDER BY o.seq LIMIT 1) AS "currentOp" FROM mes_work_order w JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = w.material_id WHERE w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_wo_op o WHERE o.wo_id = w.id AND o.work_center_id = #{wc}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN w.plan_end IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, w.plan_end, w.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "active", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND w.plan_end < #{day} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "overdue", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.finish_time >= #{day} AND w.finish_time < #{nextDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "completed" FROM mes_work_order w WHERE w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED', 'COMPLETED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_wo_op o WHERE o.wo_id = w.id AND o.work_center_id = #{wc})

SELECT r.create_time AS "time", r.report_date AS "day", w.wo_no AS "woNo", o.name AS "op", u.nickname AS "operator", e.name AS "equipment", r.good_qty AS "good", r.scrap_qty AS "scrap" FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op o ON o.id = r.op_id JOIN mes_work_order w ON w.id = r.wo_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.operator_id LEFT JOIN mes_equipment e ON e.id = r.equipment_id o.work_center_id = #{wc} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE kind = 'IN' AND biz_type = 'PRODUCTION' AND status = 'DONE' AND biz_date = #{day}

SELECT kind AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "docs", COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE status = 'DONE' AND kind IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY kind

SELECT biz_date AS "day", kind AS "kind", SUM(total_qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE status = 'DONE' AND kind IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY biz_date, kind ORDER BY biz_date

SELECT d.kind AS "kind", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, d.biz_type) AS "label", SUM(d.total_qty) AS "qty", d.biz_type AS "value" FROM wms_stock_doc d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN 'wms_in_type' ELSE 'wms_out_type' END AND dd.dict_value = d.biz_type WHERE d.status = 'DONE' AND d.kind IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY d.kind, d.biz_type, dd.dict_label ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT w.name AS "name", COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS "qty", COUNT(DISTINCT s.material_id) AS "skus" FROM wms_warehouse w LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND s.qty > 0 WHERE w.status = 1 GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.sort ORDER BY w.sort, w.id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT material_id) AS "skus", COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock WHERE qty > 0
mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.unit, m.safety_stock, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS qty FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.material_id = m.id WHERE m.safety_stock > 0 AND m.status = 1 GROUP BY m.id, m.code, m.name, m.unit, m.safety_stock HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) < m.safety_stock
mapper.select: SELECT t.code AS "code", t.name AS "name", t.unit AS "unit", t.qty AS "qty", t.safety_stock AS "safety" FROM () t ORDER BY t.qty / t.safety_stock, t.code LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () t
mapper.sql: SELECT m.code, m.name, b.batch_no, b.expiry_date, SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM wms_batch b JOIN wms_stock s ON s.material_id = b.material_id AND s.batch_no = b.batch_no AND s.qty > 0 JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = b.material_id WHERE b.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND b.expiry_date <= #{until} GROUP BY m.code, m.name, b.batch_no, b.expiry_date
mapper.select: SELECT t.code AS "code", t.name AS "name", t.batch_no AS "batchNo", t.expiry_date AS "expiryDate", t.qty AS "qty" FROM () t ORDER BY t.expiry_date, t.code LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () t

SELECT d.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", c.name AS "customer", w.name AS "warehouse", d.ship_date AS "shipDate", d.status AS "status", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, d.status) AS "statusLabel" FROM scm_delivery d LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'scm_delivery_status' AND dd.dict_value = d.status WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING', 'PICKED') ORDER BY d.ship_date, d.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "pending", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PICKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "picked", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SHIPPED' AND ship_date = #{day} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "shipped" FROM scm_delivery WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PICKED') OR (status = 'SHIPPED' AND ship_date = #{day})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_doc WHERE status = 'TRANSIT'

SELECT d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.kind AS "kind", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'TRANSFER' THEN '调拨' ELSE d.biz_type END) AS "typeLabel", w.name AS "warehouse", d.total_qty AS "qty", d.confirm_time AS "time", d.biz_type AS "bizType" FROM wms_stock_doc d LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN 'wms_in_type' ELSE 'wms_out_type' END AND dd.dict_value = d.biz_type WHERE d.status IN ('DONE', 'TRANSIT') AND d.confirm_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.confirm_time DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR'

SELECT YEAR(order_date) * 100 + MONTH(order_date) AS "period", SUM(total_amount) AS "amount" FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED') AND order_date >= #{begin} AND order_date <= #{end} GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) * 100 + MONTH(order_date)

SELECT YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date) AS "period", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN total_amount ELSE -total_amount END) AS "amount" FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date)

SELECT c.name AS "name", t.amount AS "amount" FROM ( SELECT partner_id, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN total_amount ELSE -total_amount END) AS amount FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY partner_id ) t JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = t.partner_id WHERE t.amount > 0 ORDER BY t.amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.name AS "name", t.amount AS "amount", t.qty AS "qty" FROM ( SELECT i.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.amount ELSE -i.amount END) AS amount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS qty FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY i.material_id ) t JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id WHERE t.amount > 0 ORDER BY t.amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.status AS "status", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, o.status) AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "orders", SUM(o.total_amount) AS "amount" FROM scm_order o LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'scm_order_status' AND dd.dict_value = o.status WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') GROUP BY o.status, dd.dict_label, dd.sort ORDER BY dd.sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND delivery_date < #{day}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_customer WHERE create_time >= #{begin}

SELECT o.order_no AS "orderNo", c.name AS "customer", o.total_amount AS "amount", o.status AS "status", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, o.status) AS "statusLabel", o.order_date AS "orderDate" FROM scm_order o LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'scm_order_status' AND dd.dict_value = o.status WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.type AS "type", COALESCE(dd.dict_label, i.type) AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "total", SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "pass", SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "fail", SUM(CASE WHEN i.result = 'CONCESSION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "concession" FROM mes_inspection i LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'mes_qc_type' AND dd.dict_value = i.type WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.inspect_date >= #{begin} AND i.inspect_date <= #{end} GROUP BY i.type, dd.dict_label, dd.sort ORDER BY dd.sort

SELECT inspect_date AS "day", COUNT(*) AS "total", SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "pass" FROM mes_inspection WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND inspect_date >= #{begin} AND inspect_date <= #{end} GROUP BY inspect_date ORDER BY inspect_date

SELECT COALESCE(dd.dict_label, i.defect_type) AS "label", COUNT(*) AS "times", SUM(i.defect_qty) AS "qty", i.defect_type AS "value" FROM mes_inspection i LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dd ON dd.dict_type = 'mes_defect_type' AND dd.dict_value = i.defect_type WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.result <> 'PASS' AND i.defect_type IS NOT NULL AND i.inspect_date >= #{begin} AND i.inspect_date <= #{end} GROUP BY i.defect_type, dd.dict_label ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.name AS "name", t.total AS "total", t.fail AS "fail" FROM ( SELECT supplier_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fail FROM mes_inspection WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND type = 'IQC' AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND inspect_date >= #{begin} AND inspect_date <= #{end} GROUP BY supplier_id ) t JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = t.supplier_id ORDER BY t.fail * 1.0 / t.total DESC, t.total DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN', 'APPROVING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "open", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{nextDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "created", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DONE' AND done_time >= #{begin} AND done_time < #{nextDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "done" FROM qms_ncr WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'APPROVING') OR create_time >= #{begin} OR done_time >= #{begin}

SELECT n.ncr_no AS "ncrNo", m.name AS "material", n.qty AS "qty", COALESCE(ds.dict_label, n.source) AS "sourceLabel", dt.dict_label AS "defectLabel", COALESCE(st.dict_label, n.status) AS "statusLabel", n.create_time AS "time", n.source AS "source", n.defect_type AS "defectType", n.status AS "status" FROM qms_ncr n JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = n.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data ds ON ds.dict_type = 'qms_ncr_source' AND ds.dict_value = n.source LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dt ON dt.dict_type = 'mes_defect_type' AND dt.dict_value = n.defect_type LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data st ON st.dict_type = 'qms_ncr_status' AND st.dict_value = n.status WHERE n.status IN ('OPEN', 'APPROVING') ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.insp_no AS "inspNo", COALESCE(dt.dict_label, i.type) AS "typeLabel", m.name AS "material", i.result AS "result", COALESCE(dr.dict_label, i.result) AS "resultLabel", i.defect_qty AS "defectQty", i.inspect_date AS "date", i.type AS "type" FROM mes_inspection i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dt ON dt.dict_type = 'mes_qc_type' AND dt.dict_value = i.type LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dr ON dr.dict_type = 'mes_qc_result' AND dr.dict_value = i.result WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY i.confirm_time DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM sys_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId}
SELECT name FROM mes_work_center WHERE id = #{id}
